lines.text: AMC ten challenge! Think it's root three over four? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 10 challenge! Think it's √3/4? Nope!

lines.text: A square has side one. What's the area of the largest triangle with three equal sides that fits inside?
lines.caption: A square has side one. What's the area of the largest triangle with 3 equal sides that fits inside?

lines.text: Flat, its side is one. Now pin a corner, and turn it!
lines.caption: Flat, its side is one. Now pin a corner, and turn it!

lines.text: Keep your eye on the side. It grows, and grows, then shrinks again.
lines.caption: Keep your eye on the side. It grows, and grows, then shrinks again.

lines.text: The biggest one sits at fifteen degrees, balanced across the diagonal.
lines.caption: The biggest one sits at 15 degrees, balanced across the diagonal.

lines.text: Its area is two root three, minus three. About forty-six percent of the square!
lines.caption: Its area is 2√3 − 3. About 46% of the square!

lines.text: The flat one, root three over four, was the trap.
lines.caption: The flat one, √3/4, was the trap.

lines.text: Did you get two root three minus three? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get 2√3 − 3? Tell me below!
